senses.gloss: אִזְדַּקֵּר to leap forth, to leap with joy; to stagger, reel.
units: <cite ref="Gittin 57a:9">Gitt. 57ᵃ</cite> <he>אִזְדַּקּוּר וכ׳</he> they leaped and ate and drank.
<cite ref="Niddah 17b:16">Nidd. 17ᵇ</cite> <he>אִזְדַּקְּרָה</he> she staggered, jumped backward; <cite ref="Niddah 57b">ib. 57ᵇ</cite>.—

<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 5">Lev. R. s. 5</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Isaiah 22:17">Is. XXII, 17</cite>, v. <cite ref="C00130"><he>גֶּבֶר</he></cite>) <he>כהדא תרנגולא … מִזְדַּקֵּר</he> Ar. (in ed. a.
<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 291">Yalk. Is. 291</cite> our w. omitted) like a (slaughtered) cock that rolls from place to place in spasmodic thrusts.
